prompt: Extreme wide establishing shot looking across a huge open-pit quarry. The far wall is a towering cliff of layered rock strata with stepped mining ledges. Embedded across the middle of that cliff is one enormous flat fossil slab: the dark stone imprint of a colossal horned beast skeleton pressed sideways into the slate, a flat silhouette at the level of the rock, NOT three-dimensional. Tiny ant-sized miners and ladders along the ledges show the staggering scale, the fossil dwarfing them. A cold blue-white necromantic glow runs along a mineral seam threading across the cliff. Deep colorless earthen quarry.
